definitions.gloss: number of items; selection; variety of goods
definitions.explanation: The number or range of different items available, especially in a shop, restaurant menu, or product lineup.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{品数|しなかず}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This shop has a large selection.

examples.japanese: ランチの{品数|しなかず}が{増|ふ}えて{嬉|うれ}しい。
examples.english: I'm happy that the lunch menu has more items now.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}{間際|まぎわ}になると{品数|しなかず}が{少|すく}なくなる。
examples.english: The selection gets smaller near closing time.

notes: Commonly used when evaluating shops and restaurants: {品数|しなかず}が{豊富|ほうふ} (rich selection), {品数|しなかず}が{少|すく}ない (limited selection). In cooking, {品数|しなかず}の{多|おお}い{食卓|しょくたく} means a dinner table with many different dishes.
